payout_quote: You earn $50* if the referred member ... open and fund a membership share and checking account ... You earn an additional $50* if the referred new member completes one of the following qualifying checking account activities within 60 days of account opening.
steps: Find your unique referral code (monthly statement, Sharonview email, or call 704-969-6700).
Give your code to friends/family to enter when they complete a membership application online or at a branch.

Friend opens and funds a membership share ($5 min) and checking ($25 min) within 7 days; earn $50. If they also complete $500 in direct deposits or 10 debit purchases within 60 days, earn another $50.
catches: Two-tier payout: $50 requires the friend to open AND fund share + checking within 7 days; the second $50 requires $500 aggregate direct deposits or 10 debit purchases within 60 days.
Both accounts must remain in good standing for 120 days from the referred member's account opening; rewards paid $50 within 7 days of opening/funding, second $50 within 60 days of activities.
Bonuses are reportable dividends on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer valid for referrals submitted June 15, 2026 - December 31, 2026; terms subject to change; one referrer per new member (no double-claiming).
Existing members may not open additional memberships to qualify; former members qualify only if closed 6+ months prior with no losses.
biggest_catch: It's $50 per referral, $100 only if your friend also completes the checking activity ($500 in direct deposits or 10 debit purchases within 60 days) — and both accounts must stay in good standing 120 days.
eligibility: Existing Sharonview FCU member 18+; referred person must be eligible for Sharonview membership (NC/SC footprint).
timing: Share your code in minutes; first $50 lands within 7 days of friend's account opening/funding, second $50 within 60 days of their qualifying activities.
